content.body: How should one interpret https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#active-parser "has not yet been stopped ". That stopped is a long algorithm spinning event loop and what not. Does "stopping" happen when that algorithm is about to be called, is being called or has been called?
and follow up, sort of related question to ^ - if we have a page whose load event has not been fired yet, we navigate away, then back, restore from bfcache, should the load event be fired then?
what I am referring to here, is an example where chrome puts a page in bfcache before the load event, and upon restore, does not fire a load event
